worlds.label: 霧港奇譚（1930 蒸汽龐克）
worlds.era: 1930 年代，蒸汽機與煤氣燈並存
worlds.place: 終年起霧的港口城市「霧港」
worlds.extra: 城裡的鐘錶最近接連停在同一時刻
worlds.goal: 查出鐘錶停擺的真相，讓霧港恢復運轉

worlds.label: 櫻丘學園（現代校園）
worlds.place: 海邊小鎮的私立櫻丘學園
worlds.extra: 學園祭前一週，社團面臨廢社危機
worlds.goal: 在學園祭成功演出，保住社團

worlds.label: 星燼王國（奇幻）
worlds.place: 被流星雨照亮的邊境王國
worlds.extra: 每年流星雨夜，古塔會打開一次
worlds.goal: 在古塔關閉前找到流星的秘密，守護王國

protagonist.name: 阿澈
protagonist.profile: 剛到城裡的見習偵探，好奇心重

characters.name: 林映月
characters.appearance: 22 歲女性，黑色長直髮，左耳上方別著銀色新月髮夾，灰藍色眼睛，白色立領襯衫配深藍背心與長裙，手上拿著黃銅懷錶
characters.personality: 冷靜聰明，外冷內熱，對謎題著迷
characters.speech: 用詞簡潔，偶爾冷幽默，不喜歡廢話
characters.relationship: 港口鐘錶行的店主，主角的委託人

characters.name: 沈硯
characters.appearance: 28 歲男性，銀白色短髮，琥珀色眼睛，左眉有一道細疤，深灰色長風衣，黑色皮手套，脖子掛著皮革護目鏡
characters.personality: 玩世不恭但重義氣，藏著過去的秘密
characters.speech: 吊兒郎當，愛叫主角「小偵探」
characters.relationship: 港口的情報販子，主角的舊識

worlds.label: Tales of Fogport (1930s steampunk)
worlds.era: the 1930s, steam engines and gas lamps side by side
worlds.place: Fogport, a harbor city wrapped in fog all year
worlds.extra: Clocks all over the city have been stopping at the very same minute
worlds.goal: Find out why the clocks stopped and get Fogport running again

worlds.label: Sakuraoka Academy (modern school)
worlds.place: Sakuraoka Academy, a private school in a seaside town
worlds.extra: One week before the school festival, the club is about to be shut down
worlds.goal: Pull off the festival performance and save the club

worlds.label: Kingdom of Starfall (fantasy)
worlds.era: a medieval age of swords and magic
worlds.place: a frontier kingdom lit by meteor showers
worlds.extra: On the night of the yearly meteor shower, the old tower opens once
worlds.goal: Uncover the secret of the falling stars before the tower closes and protect the kingdom

protagonist.name: Ash
protagonist.profile: an apprentice detective new to the city, endlessly curious

characters.name: Luna
characters.appearance: 22-year-old woman, long straight black hair, silver crescent-moon hairpin above her left ear, grey-blue eyes, white stand-collar shirt with a navy vest and long skirt, holding a brass pocket watch
characters.personality: calm and clever, cool outside but warm inside, fascinated by puzzles
characters.speech: brief and precise, dry humor now and then, dislikes small talk
characters.relationship: owner of the harbor clock shop, your client

characters.name: Silas
characters.appearance: 28-year-old man, short silver-white hair, amber eyes, thin scar over his left eyebrow, long dark grey trench coat, black leather gloves, leather goggles around his neck
characters.personality: flippant but loyal, hiding secrets from his past
characters.speech: laid-back and teasing, calls you "little detective"
characters.relationship: information broker at the harbor, an old acquaintance of yours
